verdict.rationale: Bento documents a dedicated Data Deletion Requests API to queue anonymization of a subscriber's data per site, directly addressing deletion control for AI-native/API-driven users. However, there's no documented broader retention policy controls (e.g., configurable retention periods, bulk/batch deletion, export-before-delete, or confirmation/status tracking of deletion jobs). Missing for 10: retention period configuration, bulk deletion tooling, deletion confirmation/audit trail, and independent verification of the deletion process working as documented.
